## R Variables
### Variables
#### Creating Variables in R
```{r tutorial_variables_variables_creatingvariables, cache=TRUE}
name <- "John"
age <- 40

name   # output "John"
age    # output 40
```

#### Print / Output Variables
```{r tutorial_variables_variables_printoutputvariables_1, cache=TRUE}
name <- "John Doe"

name # auto-print the value of the name variable
```
```{r tutorial_variables_variables_printoutputvariables_2, cache=TRUE}
name <- "John Doe"

print(name) # print the value of the name variable
```
```{r tutorial_variables_variables_printoutputvariables_3, cache=TRUE}
for (x in 1:10) {
  print(x)
}
```

### Concatenate Elements
```{r tutorial_variables_concatenateelements_1, cache=TRUE}
text <- "awesome"

paste("R is", text)
```
```{r tutorial_variables_concatenateelements_2, cache=TRUE}
text1 <- "R is"
text2 <- "awesome"

paste(text1, text2)
```
```{r tutorial_variables_concatenateelements_3, cache=TRUE}
num1 <- 5
num2 <- 10

num1 + num2
```
```{r tutorial_variables_concatenateelements_4, cache=TRUE, eval=FALSE}
num <- 5
text <- "Some text"

num + text
```

### Multiple Variables
```{r tutorial_variables_multiplevariables_1, cache=TRUE}
# Assign the same value to multiple variables in one line
var1 <- var2 <- var3 <- "Orange"

# Print variable values
var1
var2
var3
```

### Variable Names
```{r tutorial_variables_variablenames_1, cache=TRUE, eval=FALSE}
# Legal variable names:
myvar <- "John"
my_var <- "John"
myVar <- "John"
MYVAR <- "John"
myvar2 <- "John"
.myvar <- "John"

# Illegal variable names:
2myvar <- "John"
my-var <- "John"
my var <- "John"
_my_var <- "John"
my_v@ar <- "John"
TRUE <- "John"
```

## R Data Types
#### Data Types
```{r tutorial_datatypes_datatypes, cache=TRUE}
my_var <- 30 # my_var is type of numeric
my_var <- "Sally" # my_var is now of type character (aka string)
```
#### Basic Data Types
```{r tutorial_datatypes_basicdatatypes, cache=TRUE}
# numeric
x <- 10.5
class(x)

# integer
x <- 1000L
class(x)

# complex
x <- 9i + 3
class(x)

# character/string
x <- "R is exciting"
class(x)

# logical/boolean
x <- TRUE
class(x)
```

## R Numbers
#### Numbers
```{r tutorial_numbers_numbers, cache=TRUE}
x <- 10.5   # numeric
y <- 10L    # integer
z <- 1i     # complex
```
#### Numeric
```{r tutorial_numbers_numeric, cache=TRUE}
x <- 10.5
y <- 55

# Print values of x and y
x
y

# Print the class name of x and y
class(x)
class(y)
```
#### Integer
```{r tutorial_numbers_integer, cache=TRUE}
x <- 1000L
y <- 55L

# Print values of x and y
x
y

# Print the class name of x and y
class(x)
class(y)
```
#### Complex
```{r tutorial_numbers_complex, cache=TRUE}
x <- 3+5i
y <- 5i

# Print values of x and y
x
y

# Print the class name of x and y
class(x)
class(y)
```
#### Type Conversion
```{r tutorial_numbers_typeconversion, cache=TRUE}
x <- 1L # integer
y <- 2 # numeric

# convert from integer to numeric:
a <- as.numeric(x)

# convert from numeric to integer:
b <- as.integer(y)

# print values of x and y
x
y

# print the class name of a and b
class(a)
class(b)
```

## R Strings
### Strings
#### String Literals
```{r tutorial_strings_strings_stringliterals, cache=TRUE}
"hello"
'hello'
```
#### Assign a String to a Variable
```{r tutorial_strings_strings_assignstringtovariable, cache=TRUE}

str # print the value of str
```
#### Multiline Strings
```{r tutorial_strings_strings_multilinestrings_1, cache=TRUE}
str <- "Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet,
consectetur adipiscing elit,
sed do eiusmod tempor incididunt
ut labore et dolore magna aliqua."

str # print the value of str
```
```{r tutorial_strings_strings_multilinestrings_2, cache=TRUE}
str <- "Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet,
consectetur adipiscing elit,
sed do eiusmod tempor incididunt
ut labore et dolore magna aliqua."

cat(str)
```
#### String Length
```{r tutorial_strings_strings_stringlength, cache=TRUE}
str <- "Hello World!"

nchar(str)
```
#### Check String
```{r tutorial_strings_strings_checkstring, cache=TRUE}
str <- "Hello World!"

grepl("H", str)

grepl("X", str)
```

```

str

```

## R Booleans
```{r tutorial_booleans_1, cache=TRUE}
10 > 9    # TRUE because 10 is greater than 9
10 == 9   # FALSE because 10 is not equal to 9
10 < 9    # FALSE because 10 is greater than 9
```
```{r tutorial_booleans_2, cache=TRUE}
a <- 10
b <- 9

a > b
```
```{r tutorial_booleans_3, cache=TRUE}
a <- 200
b <- 33

if (b > a) {
  print ("b is greater than a")
} else {
  print("b is not greater than a")
}
```

## R Operators
#### Operators
```{r tutorial_operators_operators, cache=TRUE}
10 + 5
```
#### Arithmetic Operators
```{r tutorial_operators_arithmeticoperators, cache=TRUE}
10 + 5
10 - 5
10 * 5
10 / 5
2 ^ 5
5 %% 2
15 %/% 2
```
#### Assignment Operators
```{r tutorial_operators_assignmentoperators, cache=TRUE}
my_var <- 3

my_var <<- 3 # global assignment

3 -> my_var

3 ->> my_var # global assignment

my_var # print my_var
```
#### Comparison Operators
```{r tutorial_operators_comparisonoperators, cache=TRUE}
5 == 5 # TRUE because 5 is equal to 5
5 == 3 # FALSE because 5 is not equal to 3
5 != 3 # returns TRUE because 5 is not equal to 3
5 > 3 # returns TRUE because 5 is greater than 3
5 < 3 # returns FALSE because 5 is not less than 3
5 >= 3 # returns TRUE because 5 is greater than, or equal, to 3
5 <= 3 # returns FALSE because 5 is neither less than or equal to 3
```

## R If ... Else 
### If ... Else
#### Conditions and If Statements
```{r tutorial_ifelse_ifelse_conditionsandifstatements, cache=TRUE}
5 == 5 # TRUE because 5 is equal to 5
5 == 3 # FALSE because 5 is not equal to 3
5 != 3 # returns TRUE because 5 is not equal to 3
5 > 3 # returns TRUE because 5 is greater than 3
5 < 3 # returns FALSE because 5 is not less than 3
5 >= 3 # returns TRUE because 5 is greater than, or equal, to 3
5 <= 3 # returns FALSE because 5 is neither less than or equal to 3
```
#### If Statement
```{r tutorial_ifelse_ifelse_ifstatement, cache=TRUE}
a <- 33
b <- 200

if (b > a) {
  print("b is greater than a")
}
```
#### Else If
```{r tutorial_ifelse_ifelse_elseif, cache=TRUE}
a <- 33
b <- 33

if (b > a) {
  print("b is greater than a")
} else if (a == b) {
  print ("a and b are equal")
}
```
#### If Else
```{r tutorial_ifelse_ifelse_ifelse_1, cache=TRUE}
a <- 200
b <- 33

if (b > a) {
  print("b is greater than a")
} else if (a == b) {
  print("a and b are equal")
} else {
  print("a is greater than b")
}
```
```{r tutorial_ifelse_ifelse_ifelse_2, cache=TRUE}
a <- 200
b <- 33

if (b > a) {
  print("b is greater than a")
} else {
  print("b is not greater than a")
}
```
### Nested If
```{r tutorial_ifelse_nestedif, cache=TRUE}
x <- 41

if (x > 10) {
  print("Above ten")
  if (x > 20) {
    print("and also above 20!")
  } else {
    print("but not above 20.")
  }
} else {
  print("below 10.")
}
```
### And Or
#### And
```{r tutorial_ifelse_andor_and, cache=TRUE}
a <- 200
b <- 33
c <- 500

if (a > b & c > a) {
  print("Both conditions are true")
}
```
#### Or
```{r tutorial_ifelse_andor_or, cache=TRUE}
a <- 200
b <- 33
c <- 500

if (a > b | a > c) {
  print("At least one of the conditions is true")
}
```

## R While Loops
#### While Loops
```{r tutorial_whileloops_whileloops, cache=TRUE}
i <- 1
while (i < 6) {
  print(i)
  i <- i + 1
}
```
#### Break
```{r tutorial_whileloops_break, cache=TRUE}
i <- 1
while (i < 6) {
  print(i)
  i <- i + 1
  if (i == 4) {
    break
  }
}
```
#### Next
```{r tutorial_whileloops_next, cache=TRUE}
i <- 0
while (i < 6) {
  i <- i + 1
  if (i == 3) {
    next
  }
  print(i)
}
```
#### Yahtzee!
```{r tutorial_whileloops_yahtzee, cache=TRUE}
dice <- 1
while (dice <= 6) {
  if (dice < 6) {
    print("No Yahtzee")
  } else {
    print("Yahtzee!")
  }
  dice <- dice + 1
}
```
